bullets.text: Ukraine has reported that bodycam video shows a deadly Russian double-tap bombing, resulting in at least 40 deaths and potentially 30 more under rubble.
A British healthcare worker with Ebola has been evacuated from the Democratic Republic of Congo to the UK and is in stable condition.
French blood storage facilities have been impacted by freezer hacks, prompting theories about the culprits.
An Australian skincare brand has been accused of using AI to copy competitors' marketing imagery on social media, sparking concerns about ethical practices in the industry.
A regional Victorian council is pioneering the use of AI camera technology to identify and measure potholes, aiming to improve road maintenance efficiency and save costs.

The Reserve Bank of Australia's assertion of 'excess demand' in the economy is being questioned by households struggling with the cost of living, suggesting a disconnect between economic policy and public experience.
Activist investor DGB Investments has successfully gained majority control of furniture maker Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. by winning three board seats.
FitLab Inc., a cardio equipment manufacturer, has filed for bankruptcy, citing the loss of a key partnership with Nike Inc. and the impact of Trump-era tariffs on its supply chain.
Credit investors are anticipating a slowdown in data center approvals following the Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections, leading to re-evaluations of related companies.
